counting: Input + output tokens; cached input is a subset of input, not an additional charge. Token totals are not dollar costs.

independent_adjudication.reason: Native-agent adjudication has no token-usage record in this experiment artifact set.

exclusions: Native-agent adjudication, authoring, orchestration, review and interrupted discovery calls are unmetered in these CLI records; absent usage is not a zero-cost claim.
full_measurement_usage_note: An all-inclusive total is unavailable because independent native-agent adjudication usage was not recorded. All captured worker, calibration-judge and blind-judge CLI event usage is included.
